# Astra-HSMC

> Astra-HSMC is an independent Layer-1 crypto network (HSMC token) with a Rust node, Stratum V2 mining, on-chain staking, a payment gateway (HSMCPay), and cross-chain bridge to BSC/ETH. Built by Ifrim George / OXR.org.

Astra-HSMC ships a full stack: a public Rust node (RocksDB, RingCT privacy, Dandelion++), BIP39 wallets with AES-256-GCM seed storage, a DEX-style swap and liquidity pools, staking with real APR, on-chain governance, merchant tools, and an AI co-pilot integrated in the user dashboard.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Astra-HSMC network, HSMC token, and live network stats.
- [Landing](/landing): Product landing page — features, tokenomics, and call-to-action to launch the app.
- [Whitepaper](/whitepaper): Technical whitepaper covering consensus, privacy protocol, tokenomics, and legal disclaimers.
- [Blockchain Node](/node): Live node telemetry, peers, mempool, and cryptographic test suite.
- [Rust Node](/rust-node): Documentation for running the public Rust node (VPS setup, Cloudflare Tunnel, Stratum V2).
- [Mainnet Hub](/mainnet): Mainnet launch command center with readiness checklist and deployment steps.
- [Mainnet Readiness](/mainnet/readiness): Detailed readiness report — contracts, bridge, liquidity, listings.
- [Investors](/investors): Investor portal — tokenomics, distribution schedule, and roadmap.
- [Listing Kit](/listing-kit): Assets and metadata for exchange listings (CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, MEXC, Gate).
